notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Auriok Windwalker does not have summoning sickness.
Medomai the Ageless exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
description:
Declare any other creature as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Auriok Windwalker by tapping it, attaching Dinosaur Headdress to the attacking creature, and causing the creature to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using the creature.
The creature triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Auriok Windwalker.
Repeat each turn.
